text: I’ve never, never been stronger and more convinced than now.” The colour had rushed into his pale exhausted face, but as he uttered his last explanation, he happened to meet Dounia’s eyes and he saw such anguish in them that he could not help being checked. He felt that he had, anyway, made these two poor women miserable, that he was, anyway, the cause... “Dounia darling, if I am guilty forgive me (though I cannot be forgiven if I am guilty). We won’t dispute. It’s time, high time to go. Don’t follow me, I beseech you, I have somewhere else to go....
